svg.title: Plate II — Figurative system of the repository
svg.desc: A brace tree of the repository: knowledge (the skill, discovery), execution (the script, the engine), proof (the renderer, the numbers) and hosts (the MCP server, the in-app agent, the harness). Beside it a truss: each of the three hosts bears on all three foundation packages — skill, script and renderer — which bear on nothing.
